select c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.industry_name, c.customer_type, c.customer_level, c.risk_level as customer_risk_level, c.kyc_status, c.blacklist_flag, c.status as customer_status, c.owner_org_name, c.relationship_manager_name, ifnull(r.rating_no, '') as rating_no, r.rating_level, r.rating_date, ifnull(l.limit_no, '') as limit_no, ifnull(l.total_limit_amount, 0) as total_limit_amount, ifnull(l.available_limit_amount, 0) as available_limit_amount, l.limit_status, ifnull(app.application_count, 0) as application_count, ifnull(app.application_amount_total, 0) as application_amount_total, ifnull(ct.contract_count, 0) as contract_count, ifnull(ct.contract_amount_total, 0) as contract_amount_total, ifnull(dr.drawdown_count, 0) as drawdown_count, ifnull(dr.actual_draw_amount_total, 0) as actual_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(co.collateral_count, 0) as collateral_count, ifnull(co.confirmed_value_total, 0) as confirmed_value_total, ifnull(rel.contract_collateral_count, 0) as contract_collateral_count, ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) as total_secured_amount, ifnull(ex.exposure_count, 0) as exposure_count, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ex.max_pd, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.max_overdue_days, 0) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(ov.overdue_amount_total, 0) as overdue_amount_total, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, ifnull(dd.default_exposure_amount_total, 0) as default_exposure_amount_total, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else '' end as highest_default_level, ifnull(cd.customer_default_no, '') as customer_default_no, ifnull(cd.default_status, '') as customer_default_status, case when ifnull(cd.default_status, '') = 'ACTIVE' or ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) > 0 then '违约' when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 then '逾期' else '正常' end as risk_state
order by case when ifnull(cd.default_status, '') = 'ACTIVE' then 1 when ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) > 0 then 2 when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 then 3 else 4 end, c.customer_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select l.id, l.limit_no, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, r.rating_level, l.limit_type, l.currency, l.total_limit_amount, l.used_limit_amount, l.frozen_limit_amount, l.available_limit_amount, l.effective_date, l.expiry_date, l.credit_rating_level, l.risk_level, l.limit_status, l.owner_org_name, l.manager_name, ifnull(app.application_count, 0) as application_count, ifnull(app.application_amount_total, 0) as application_amount_total, ifnull(ct.contract_count, 0) as contract_count, ifnull(ct.contract_amount_total, 0) as contract_amount_total, ifnull(ct.available_draw_amount_total, 0) as available_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.drawdown_count, 0) as drawdown_count, ifnull(dr.actual_draw_amount_total, 0) as actual_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(ex.exposure_count, 0) as exposure_count, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ex.max_pd, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.max_overdue_days, 0) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else '' end as highest_default_level
order by case when l.limit_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 2 end, l.expiry_date, l.limit_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.sql:
from corporate_credit_application app join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = app.customer_no_snapshot left join corporate_rating r on r.active_customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_limit l on l.id = app.related_limit_id left join corporate_credit_contract ct on ct.application_no_snapshot = app.application_no and ct.deleted_flag = 0 left join ( select application_id, count(*) as drawdown_count, sum(actual_draw_amount) as actual_draw_amount_total, sum(outstanding_principal_amount) as outstanding_principal_amount_total from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 group by application_id ) dr on dr.application_id = app.id left join ( select contract_no, count(*) as collateral_relation_count, sum(secured_amount) as total_secured_amount from corporate_credit_contract_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 and relation_status = 'ACTIVE' group by contract_no ) rel on rel.contract_no = ct.contract_no left join ( select contract_no, count(*) as exposure_count, sum(ead_amount) as ead_amount_total, max(pd) as max_pd, sum(el_avg) as el_avg_total from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 group by contract_no ) ex on ex.contract_no = ct.contract_no left join ( select contract_no, count(*) as overdue_count, max(overdue_days) as max_overdue_days from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 group by contract_no ) ov on ov.contract_no = ct.contract_no left join ( select contract_no, count(*) as debt_default_count, min(case default_level when 'A' then 1 when 'B' then 2 when 'C' then 3 else 9 end) as highest_default_rank from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 group by contract_no ) dd on dd.contract_no = ct.contract_no where app.deleted_flag = 0 and c.deleted_flag = 0
and ( app.application_no like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') or c.customer_no like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') or c.customer_name like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') or ifnull(l.limit_no, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') or ifnull(ct.contract_no, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') or app.product_type like concat('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') )
and c.customer_no like concat('%', #{criteria.customerNo}, '%')
and r.rating_level = #{criteria.ratingLevel}
and (c.risk_level = #{criteria.riskLevel} or ifnull(app.customer_risk_level, '') = #{criteria.riskLevel})
and (app.product_type like concat('%', #{criteria.productType}, '%') or ifnull(ct.product_type, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.productType}, '%'))
and (app.application_status = #{criteria.status} or ifnull(ct.contract_status, '') = #{criteria.status})
and exists ( select 1 from corporate_debt_default x where x.contract_no = ct.contract_no and x.deleted_flag = 0 and x.default_level = #{criteria.defaultLevel} )
and ( ifnull(app.owner_org_name, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.ownerOrgName}, '%') or ifnull(ct.owner_org_name, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.ownerOrgName}, '%') or ifnull(c.owner_org_name, '') like concat('%', #{criteria.ownerOrgName}, '%') )
and date(coalesce(ct.sign_date, app.approved_at, app.submitted_at, app.created_at)) >= #{criteria.startDate}
and date(coalesce(ct.sign_date, app.approved_at, app.submitted_at, app.created_at)) <= #{criteria.endDate}
mapper.select:
select app.id, app.application_no, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, r.rating_level, ifnull(l.limit_no, '') as limit_no, app.application_type, app.product_type, app.apply_amount, app.apply_term_months, app.apply_rate, app.risk_assessment_result, app.application_status, date_format(app.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as submitted_at, date_format(app.approved_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as approved_at, ifnull(ct.contract_no, '') as contract_no, ifnull(ct.contract_name, '') as contract_name, ifnull(ct.contract_amount, 0) as contract_amount, ifnull(ct.used_draw_amount, 0) as used_draw_amount, ifnull(ct.available_draw_amount, 0) as available_draw_amount, ct.sign_date, ct.effective_date, ct.expiry_date, ifnull(ct.contract_status, '') as contract_status, ifnull(dr.drawdown_count, 0) as drawdown_count, ifnull(dr.actual_draw_amount_total, 0) as actual_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(rel.collateral_relation_count, 0) as collateral_relation_count, ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) as total_secured_amount, ifnull(ex.exposure_count, 0) as exposure_count, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ex.max_pd, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.max_overdue_days, 0) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else '' end as highest_default_level, app.owner_org_name, app.manager_name
order by case when ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) > 0 then 1 when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 then 2 else 3 end, app.created_at desc, app.application_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

order by case when dd.id is not null then 1 when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 then 2 else 3 end, dr.drawdown_date desc, dr.drawdown_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select ov.id, ov.overdue_no, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, r.rating_level, ov.contract_no, ov.debt_no, ifnull(ov.drawdown_no, '') as drawdown_no, ov.product_type, ov.due_date, ov.overdue_date, ov.overdue_days, ov.grace_days, ov.grace_due_date, ov.legal_holiday_flag, ov.total_overdue_amount, ov.remaining_overdue_amount, ov.repayment_status, ov.collection_status, ov.default_flag, ov.five_category, ov.risk_level as overdue_risk_level, ifnull(ex.exposure_no, '') as exposure_no, ifnull(ex.ead_amount, 0) as ead_amount, ifnull(ex.pd, 0) as pd, ifnull(ex.lgd_avg, 0) as lgd_avg, ifnull(ex.el_avg, 0) as el_avg, ifnull(dd.debt_default_no, '') as debt_default_no, ifnull(dd.default_level, '') as default_level, dd.default_date, ifnull(dd.default_exposure_amount, 0) as default_exposure_amount, ifnull(dd.loss_amount, 0) as loss_amount, ifnull(dd.default_status, '') as default_status, ifnull(cd.customer_default_no, '') as customer_default_no, ifnull(cd.highest_default_level, '') as customer_default_level, ifnull(cd.default_status, '') as customer_default_status, ov.owner_org_name, ov.manager_name
